title: A multiscale chemo-electro-mechanical skeletal muscle model to analyze muscle contraction and force generation for different muscle fiber arrangements
attribution: Copyright 2014 Heidlauf and Röhrle. Source article retained under CC BY 4.0; Phydrax continuum implementation independently derived from the published equations.
implemented_scope: Section 2.2, Eqs. (1)-(2), continuum rows of Table 2: passive/active exact-incompressible muscle with caller-prescribed homogenized normalized active stress

a0.support: one prepared uniform reference fiber family

gamma_bar.support: already homogenized material point or FE quadrature
gamma_bar.sign: source-signed; no clipping or [0,1] activation bound

equation_decisions.compression: Eq. (1) gives no piecewise tension branch. Retain signed b1*(lambda^(d1-2)-lambda^-2) for every positive lambda.
equation_decisions.deformation: Use source F and C without an isochoric projection or deviatoric pressure redefinition.
equation_decisions.active: Pact=Pmax*gamma_bar; no extra macroscopic force-length or force-velocity factor. Active stress is imposed separately from stored passive energy.
equation_decisions.mixed_numerical_realization: Core CellResidualAction displacement residual int P:grad(v) and pressure residual int -log(J)*q. Pressure is compression-positive; -p*log(J) gives the exact source -p*F^-T at off-constraint trial states.
equation_decisions.gauge: An explicit pressure_origin_pa maps core pressure increment to source pressure. Passive rest uses origin=2*c10+4*c01. The origin is identified, not silently inferred.

numerical_cases.material: positive-J compression, rest, tension, shear, objectivity, independent NumPy Eq.1 oracle, passive energy derivative, tangent finite difference and active virtual power
numerical_cases.fe: unit reference tetrahedron, native P2/P1 pressure-increment mean-zero gauge, affine active gamma, exact integral gamma dV and source derivative
numerical_cases.initial_state: manufactured u=0 and p_increment=0; passive stress-free source pressure origin explicitly supplied
numerical_cases.boundary_conditions: manufactured zero traction at passive rest; affine virtual displacement is an integration probe, not a biological contraction boundary protocol

not_claimed: moving-geometry fiber diffusion or conservative cellular transfer
Fig. 4-10 trace reproduction or held-out physiological validation
